why: This is a top headline, but its figures (about 30% counted, Labour 29.9 v National 29.4) date from 7:13 pm NZDT, which is 11:43 am IST, nearly three hours ago. The count will have moved a long way since then. The Hindi key point also says the gap is 'आधा प्रतिशत से भी कम' (less than half a percent), but it is exactly 0.5 points. The main picture is a soft, low-resolution, tightly cropped shot of Chris Hipkins with the top of his head cut off. Its alt text says it shows Christopher Luxon.
